pois.name: The Eliott Memorial
pois.description: Memorial to General George Augustus Eliott, later Lord Heathfield, who defended Gibraltar during the Great Siege 1779 - 1782. ELIOTT Built: 1858. Wikipedia: en:Gibraltar Botanic Gardens#The Eliott Memorial

pois.name: Duke of Wellington Monument
pois.description: Bronze bust on an Aswan Pink column, 2 13 inch mortars a replica 1758 bronze 12-pounder gun. The bust had been cast in bronze from guns captured by the Duke of Wellington. It stands on a marble pillar that had been brought from the Roman ruins of Lepida Built: 1819-04.

pois.name: Admiral Lord Nelson
pois.description: The statue shows Nelson as he was when he last arrived at Gibraltar. The sculpture was commissioned by the Government of Gibraltar and is cast in part from copper taken from HMS Victory which visited the harbour on a number of occasions.

pois.name: Led by shepherd 500 Spanish soldiers...
pois.description: Led by shepherd 500 Spanish soldiers climbed the east face of the rock in 704 from Catalan Bay to surprise the garrison, but they were discovered and made prisioner. The shepher's path from near this spot was scraped away soon afterwards.
